facts.summary: Company touted positive mid-year interim data, no explanation for drop · Phase 2 · Ampligen plus durvalumab in metastatic pancreatic cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: AIM ImmunoTech Reports Positive Mid-year Safety and Efficacy Data from Phase 2 Study Evaluating Ampligen® (rintatolimod) in Combination with AstraZeneca’s Imfinzi® (durvalumab) for the Treatment of Pancreatic Cancer
evidence.safety: Our preliminary data suggests that the combination of Ampligen and durvalumab is well-tolerated in post-FOLFIRINOX pancreatic cancer patients
